zq.hurl.follow._orig: the follow-through: the arms coming back, the weight settling

zq.sling.release._orig: the release at full reach: the arm straight like a thrown blade, the other hand staying at the chin

zq.sling.follow._orig: the arm left out where it let go, the weight coming back

zq.turn_throw.release._orig: let go with his back to where he first faced: the arm thrown out to the side

zq.turn_throw.follow._orig: settling out of the turn, the guard coming back up

zq.back_throw.load._orig: dropped under the rival: the knees bent, one hand on each side of their waist, never joined

zq.back_throw.release._orig: arched back: the arms swept up and over, the rival leaving over his shoulder

zq.drive_down.load._orig: the rival lifted to shoulder height on both forearms: the forearms up and forward, the elbows in, the hands apart

zq.drive_down.release._orig: driven down ahead of him: the arms thrust down and forward, his weight falling in behind them

zq.drive_down.follow._orig: following the drive down, low, the arms still reaching

zq.spike.load._orig: risen a body length with the rival hanging from the collar hand: the arm up beside his head, the other hand at his chest

zq.spike.release._orig: the arm whipped down past his own knee, the body folding over it

zq.spike.follow._orig: low after the spike, the arm still down

zq.lift.load._orig: open hands under the rival's arms at the shoulders: the hands apart, the knees bent to lift

zq.lift.release._orig: a rising turn that sends him up: the arms thrown up, the legs straightening

zq.lift.follow._orig: the arms coming down, watching him go up

zq.jolt.release._orig: a straight shove upward from the hips: the legs straightening, the arm driving up
